game.title: Ran Maa (Gold Leaf Game)
game.description: A traditional game using woven palm leaves, where players create intricate patterns and compete in design complexity and speed of weaving.
howToPlay: Step 1: Collect and prepare dried palm leaves.
Step 2: Cut leaves into uniform strips.
Step 3: Players weave strips into predetermined patterns.
Step 4: Competition based on speed of weaving.
Step 5: Alternatively, judges evaluate design complexity and beauty.
Step 6: Traditional patterns are taught by elders to youth.
Step 7: Completed weavings can be used as decorations.
Step 8: Game preserves traditional craft skills.
Step 9: Winners recognized for their craftsmanship.
Step 10: Often played during cultural festivals.
